Frequently Asked Questions 

What is Prophet AI and how does it help a Security Operations Center? 

Prophet AI is an agentic AI SOC analyst platform that autonomously triages and investigates alerts. It gathers evidence across your stack, reasons about context, and explains each decision so analysts resolve alerts faster and with less manual work. 

How fast can Prophet AI investigate an alert? 

Prophet AI investigates alerts in under 3 minutes versus the 30-minutes baseline many teams report, cutting mean time to investigate by more than 90%. 

Is customer data used to train Prophet AI model? 

No. Prophet AI does not use customer data to train Gen AI models and Prophet AI's single tenant architecture ensures no data co-mingling across customer, further ensuring maximum privacy and data security. 

How do I measure return on investment (ROI) of Prophet AI 

Track alert dwell time, mean time to investigate, and mean time to resolve before and after rollout. Customers typically see a five to ten times productivity gain and cost savings in analyst hours.
